# SPDX validation schema

[spdx-2.3.schema.json](spdx-2.3.schema.json) is the SPDX Workgroup's [SPDX 2.3 JSON schema](https://github.com/spdx/spdx-spec/blob/v2.3/schemas/spdx-schema.json), retrieved 2026-11-04. JSON whitespace is formatted for this repository; the schema is otherwise unchanged. SPDX 2.3 remains the format generated by the release tool. Schema validation does not prove inventory completeness or security qualification.

The upstream specification/schema is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported. The complete upstream [license](https://github.com/spdx/spdx-spec/blob/v2.3/LICENSE) is preserved in [SPDX-LICENSE.txt](SPDX-LICENSE.txt). Attribution: SPDX Workgroup, SPDX specification v2.3. These files and AJV are build tooling, outside the four-file browser distribution.
